editorial_rules: Every story is original and suitable for a general audience of adults and teenagers.
Never speak to the viewer as a child or as a parent of a child.
No graphic violence, cruelty, or unsafe behaviour shown as fun.
No brands, products, real people, places of worship or current events.
Use clear sentences and everyday words.

cast.visual_descriptor: a woman in her thirties with short dark hair, a mustard scarf, a grey coat and a calm, curious expression
cast.personality: observant, patient and quietly funny; notices what others miss

story.writing_style: Clear sentences, everyday words, a calm and confident voice.
morals: Small choices shape who we become.
Listening is a kind of courage.
What we keep is less than what we give.
story.question_style: "What do you think happens next?" style questions for viewers

visuals.judge_criteria: Pick the picture that best matches the scene, keeps every character on model, looks natural and has no text in it.
